assumptions: Public US individual-plan benchmarks, not the user invoice or a market-share ranking.
No taxes, FX fees, promotions or regional checkout adjustments included.
Annualized monthly plans assume 12 full monthly payments.
Only count a recurring expense after successful replacement and cancellation; never add two billing plans for the same product.

One representative paid tool is selected per category; Adobe is represented once by Photoshop, hosted collaboration/cloud-storage/browser-first design services are excluded, and the basket is illustrative rather than a complete list of paid tools.
Migration time, hardware, hosting, storage and APIs are separate costs.
Existing perpetual licenses and already-free tools do not automatically create annual savings.
Free/open-source candidates are conditional starting points, not proof of full feature equivalence.
